prompts:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: text-free illustrated BACK design for an original HEBUT aerospace collectible card set, 2:3 portrait. This will receive a separate ivory border and editable typography in production.

Create a beautifully composed, restrained retro 2009–2013 casual browser-game collectible-card back illustration. Refined 2D digital painting with very soft paper grain, fine clean drawn outlines, gentle gradients, a little hand-painted shading. Dreamy, welcoming, collectible, suitable for university students; not infantile, not photorealistic or 3D.

Overall composition is centered and elegantly balanced LEFT/RIGHT. The ground is a muted deep blue (#244D70) at the edges and a softer dusty celestial blue (#547F9E) around the center, with subtle subdued sky-blue and lilac shading. In the exact central area, one large illustrated circular celestial medallion: a softly painted rich azure-blue circular sky disk, an elegant large four-point ivory-and-pale-gold guiding star centered on the disk, two or three thin sweeping pale-gold elliptical orbital ribbons wrapping gracefully around the disk. A few tiny round planet-like beads on the orbits. This is a friendly celestial decorative emblem, not a scientific diagram or futuristic HUD. The star has a softly hand-shaded beveled painted quality, never 3D plastic or intense neon. Keep the central medallion compact, approximately 55% of canvas width, centered at 50% canvas height, with all orbital curves inside 76% canvas width.

Paint delicate soft ivory/cream and light blue cartoon cloud banks only along the bottom corners, with smaller subtle complementary wisps at the top corners, leaving the center and typography areas clear. Add only 6–8 widely spaced little four-point stars/points as restrained decoration. Airy spacing, not a dense star field. No mechanical devices on the back, because this is shared by all seven aerospace subjects.

Reserve completely calm, dark blue areas across the TOP CENTER from 12% to 25% of image height and BOTTOM CENTER from 79% to 90% for typography to be added later. Do not paint banners or blank rectangles there. Keep important imagery away from outer 7% edges. Full bleed painted background. NO card border, NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logos, NO watermark. No metallic sci-fi frame, no photoreal rendering, no clay or toy style, no lens flare, no bright neon. Portrait 2:3 canvas.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the edit target: a shared collectible card back illustration.
Make ONE targeted refinement: simplify the celestial disk's surface and tiny speckles so it matches a clean 2D cartoon hand-painted casual browser-game card set. Remove the hundreds of tiny stars, white dots, glitter, scratches and noisy nebula flecks inside the large blue central disk. Replace them with smooth, softly brushed broad blue and light-lilac gradients and a few simple softly painted cloudlike color patches. There should be at most 5 small subtle luminous accents within the disk, not a dense star field. Also remove the tiny pinprick speckles outside the disk, retaining only the 6–8 larger, widely spaced four-point stars around the overall design. Keep illustration linework and soft painterly edges, not vector-flat and not 3D.
Preserve everything else: the centered large ivory/gold four-point star, all golden orbital ribbons and planet beads, the same sizes and positions and their balanced composition, restrained muted blue color scheme, soft cream corner clouds, and the same calm clear empty top and bottom areas for text. Keep the full-bleed portrait 2:3 format. No lettering, numbers, frame or watermark. Elegant and airy, no bright neon, no added detail.
composition: 1024×1536；底卡/无字插画/矢量卡框/可编辑文字分层；金色四芒星与轨道呼应正面星标。
